name: Save (ex Solend) lending program

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: The lending program's upgrade authority is a single on-curve key with no multisig wrapper: one signature can replace its code, with no delay. That is the bottom rung of the scale.
narrative.detail: Live-verified on 2026-09-17 and re-checked on 2026-09-20. The key was rotated on 2026-04-04 by direct signatures between two on-curve keys, so it is live and used; the program was last upgraded on 2025-07-02. The lending market owner was not decoded and cannot lower a bare-key score. This is a different target from Solend DAO governance above. DefiLlama listed over $50M TVL on 2026-09-17.

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: Admin power is not a bare key
main_gap.reason: One key, or a tiny group, can change it

independent_read.path: program -> ProgramData DMCvGv… -> upgrade authority (on the curve: a plain key)
independent_read.posture: admin: a plain key; delay: none
